ValidationRule.description: Without the proper permission, in this case custom ppermission, users can not edit Geo, Region or Sub Region fields.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: NOT( $Permission.Modify_Geo_Region_and_Sub_Region) && (ISCHANGED( Geo__c ) || ISCHANGED( Region__c ) || ISCHANGED( Sub_Region__c ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You can not edit the Geo, Region or Sub Region fields without permission. Please reach out to you Salesforce Administrator with the updates you would like to make.
